name: VM5a
description: A six-layer radial viscosity profile, prescribed for GIAMIP experiments Exp01 and Exp06. It is a viscosity structure only: the elastic structure is PREM and the rheology is Maxwell.

source.citation: Roy, K. and Peltier, W. R. (2017). Space-geodetic and water level gauge constraints on continental uplift and tilting over North America. Geophysical Journal International 210(2), 1115-1142, table 2. Reproduced in the GIAMIP protocol v2.4, section 3.1.1.

notes: The protocol tabulates viscosity in units of 1e21 Pa s. The values here are in Pa s.
The 100-420 km and 420-670 km layers carry the same viscosity, so the profile has five distinct values across six layers.
The protocol states that each group may choose its own treatment of compressibility.
